# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "calibration",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "calibration-theory.html",
    Implementation = "calibration-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "calibration-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "calibration-validation.html"
  )
)
```

SOEMS is validated against a radial finite-element solution for a solid elastic sphere with a spherical DtN radiation condition. The reference solve treats the sphere as an elastic solid supporting longitudinal and shear potentials, then enforces pressure continuity, normal-velocity continuity, and zero tangential traction at the water-solid boundary.

::: {.tip data-title="Scope"}
The validation grid covers frequency response, monostatic orientation, diameter, and elastic material properties. The orientation rows are included as a rotational-invariance check for the spherical geometry.
:::

| Frequency sweep | radial FEM with spherical DtN | 8 | 12-120 kHz | 90 deg | 38.1 mm | WC | 0.000787 | 0.005930 |
| Orientation sweep | radial FEM with spherical DtN | 7 | 38 kHz | 0-180 deg | 38.1 mm | WC | 0.000015 | 0.000015 |
| Diameter sweep | radial FEM with spherical DtN | 4 | 38 kHz | 90 deg | 20-60 mm | WC | 0.000035 | 0.000055 |
| Material sweep | radial FEM with spherical DtN | 5 | 38 kHz | 90 deg | 38.1 mm | WC, Cu, Al, steel, brass | 0.000084 | 0.000212 |
